about: Settings for the battery pack calculator on the Bidding desk. Cell prices come from the site's live data; every other cost here is a modelled starting value for a China-built LFP pack, not a published price. Change a default only with a better source, and note it below.

cells.label: EV prismatic LFP cell
cells.note: TrendForce publishes one average price for EV prismatic LFP cells of all sizes, so every EV cell size here uses the same price per kWh.

preset_note: Pack sizes and voltages are typical round numbers for each use, not a particular model. Published e-bus and e-truck packs are listed on the Packs & systems step.
default_note: Part costs are modelled starting values in US$ for a China-built LFP pack, not published prices or quotes. They were set so the results sit near BloombergNEF's 2025 figures: cells about 80% of a car pack's price, Chinese bus and truck packs dearer than car packs, and storage packs the cheapest. Replace them with your own quotes.

duty.cells_text: Lithium-ion cells imported to make EV battery packs pay 5% basic customs duty (Notification 45/2025-Customs, S.No. 321); the Union Budget 2026-27 extended that entry to 31 March 2028. Cells for other packs had the same 5% (S.No. 319); whether that entry was also extended could not be confirmed, and without it the 10% general rate (S.No. 325) applies.
duty.packs_text: Battery packs imported for making EVs pay 15% (S.No. 322 of the same notification); stationary storage batteries pay the concessional 10% (S.No. 325), as CBIC confirmed in October 2026. A 10% social welfare surcharge is added on the duty, and IGST (usually credited) is left out.

benchmarks.what: Average pack in China, all uses, 2025
Bus and commercial vehicle packs in China, 2025 (outside China: $182)
Battery-electric car packs, 2025: cells were $79, 80% of the pack price

notes.what: Cells are most of the cost
notes.text: In a teardown of US heavy-truck packs, cells were about 80% of the pack's bill of materials.
notes.source: Ricardo for ICCT, e-truck virtual teardown (2021)

notes.text: For a given voltage the number of cells in series is fixed, so bigger cells mean fewer cells in parallel: fewer welds, busbars, holders and handling steps. Battery management and the high-voltage box hardly change with cell size.

profile_note: Three sets of starting values: heavy buses and trucks (sturdier housings, liquid cooling, a full high-voltage box), light commercial vehicles (smaller, simpler packs) and storage packs (one rack module: no high-voltage box, which sits in the rack, and a lighter housing). Choosing a use resets the part costs to its set.
